lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF is an Investor Selling Shareholder, with up to ₹3.41 crore from selling up to 25,200 shares in the offer.
The proceeds have been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), so the money has already arrived.
The shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, which is a recent trigger.
Up to ₹2.52 crore gain before offer expenses and taxes; the holder is expected to retain ₹7.95 crore (estimate, valued at offer price).
